# UI/UX Audit Report: Nilov Catering Menu Section (Desktop)  
*Prepared by: Senior UI/UX Auditor*  


## 1. Visual Quality Issues  
### Alignment & Spacing  
- **Header Navigation**: The logo ("NILOV CATERIN") is left-aligned, while the navigation menu ("ФОРМАТЫ," "МЕНЮ," etc.) is centered—creating a disjointed horizontal flow. The "ЗАКАЗАТЬ" button (gold) is right-aligned, but its padding and position relative to the phone number (+7 (812) 919-59-11) feel unbalanced (e.g., the button is too close to the phone number, reducing whitespace).  
- **Hero Section**: The "Примеры меню" heading is centered, but the subheading ("Шеф-повар подберёт идеальное сочетание блюд под ваш формат") is left-aligned—breaking visual consistency. The tab buttons ("ФУРШЕТ," "БАНКЕТ," "КОФЕ-БРЕЙК") are centered, but the spacing between tabs (e.g., "ФУРШЕТ" to "БАНКЕТ") is inconsistent (too tight on the left, too loose on the right).  
- **Menu Items**: The two-column layout of menu items (e.g., "Канапе с сыром" vs. "Тарталетки с красной икрой") has uneven vertical spacing between rows—some items are spaced 20px apart, others 30px, disrupting rhythm.  

### Contrast  
- **Text vs. Background**: The subheading ("Шеф-повар подберёт...") uses a light gray (#AAAAAA) on a black background—failing WCAG 2.1 AA contrast standards (minimum 4.5:1). This makes the text hard to read for users with low vision.  
- **Tab Buttons**: The active tab ("ФУРШЕТ") uses gold text on a gold background—no contrast, making it impossible to distinguish from the inactive tabs (gray text on black).  

### Typography  
- **Font Hierarchy**: The heading "Примеры меню" uses a large, elegant serif font (likely *Playfair Display*), but the subheading uses a smaller, sans-serif font (likely *Roboto*)—creating a jarring contrast. The menu item text (e.g., "Канапе с сыром") uses a medium-weight sans-serif, but the font size is too small (14px) for readability on desktop.  
- **Consistency**: The navigation menu uses a sans-serif font (e.g., *Arial*), while the logo uses a serif font—undermining brand cohesion.  


## 2. Tab/Button Design  
- **Active State Clarity**: The active tab ("ФУРШЕТ") uses gold text on a gold background—no visual distinction from the inactive tabs (gray text on black). Users cannot easily identify which tab is selected.  
- **Inactive State**: Inactive tabs ("БАНКЕТ," "КОФЕ-БРЕЙК") use gray text on a black background—low contrast, making them hard to scan.  
- **Button Padding**: The "ЗАКАЗАТЬ" button has minimal padding (e.g., 10px left/right), making it feel cramped. The rounded corners are too sharp (90°), lacking the premium feel of the brand.  


## 3. Content Readability  
- **Subheading Legibility**: The subheading ("Шеф-повар подберёт...") is too light (gray) and small (16px)—users struggle to read it quickly.  
- **Menu Item Text**: Menu items (e.g., "Мини-брускетти с томатами и моцареллой") use 14px text with insufficient line height (1.2)—text feels cramped, especially for longer names.  
- **Information Hierarchy**: The "Меню формируется индивидуально..." note at the bottom is too small (12px) and gray—users may miss critical context about customization.  


## 4. Specific Improvement Suggestions  
### Visual Quality  
- **Alignment**: Align the navigation menu to the left (matching the logo) or center the logo to create a cohesive header. Increase whitespace between the phone number and "ЗАКАЗАТЬ" button (e.g., 20px) to improve balance.  
- **Contrast**:  
  - Change the subheading to a lighter gold (#D4AF37) or white (#FFFFFF) to meet contrast standards.  
  - Use a dark gray (#333333) for inactive tab text to improve readability.  
- **Typography**:  
  - Use a consistent serif font (e.g., *Playfair Display*) for all headings and a sans-serif font (e.g., *Roboto*) for body text to unify the design.  
  - Increase menu item font size to 16px and line height to 1.5 for better readability.  

### Tab/Button Design  
- **Active State**: Add a dark gray background (#222222) to the active tab ("ФУРШЕТ") with gold text to create clear contrast.  
- **Inactive State**: Use gold text on a black background for inactive tabs to maintain brand consistency.  
- **Button Styling**: Increase padding for the "ЗАКАЗАТЬ" button (e.g., 15px left/right) and soften rounded corners (e.g., 8px) for a premium look.  

### Content Readability  
- **Subheading**: Increase the subheading font size to 18px and use a gold color (#D4AF37) to draw attention.  
- **Menu Items**: Add a 10px margin between menu item rows to improve vertical rhythm.  
- **Customization Note**: Increase the font size of the bottom note to 14px and use a light gold color (#D4AF37) to make it more noticeable.  


## Summary  
The menu section has strong branding (gold/black color scheme) but suffers from inconsistent alignment, poor contrast, and unclear tab design. Prioritizing contrast improvements, typography consistency, and tab usability will enhance the premium feel and user experience.  

*Next Steps*: Implement these changes and conduct A/B testing to validate readability and engagement.  

---  
*Nilov Catering UI/UX Audit | Date: [Insert Date]*
